rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone who fraudulently pretends to be another person.

example.english: The police caught an impersonator who pretended to be a bank employee to scam people.
example.traditional: 警方捉到個冒充者，佢冒充銀行職員呃人。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zuk1 dou2 go3 mou6 cung1 ze2 keoi5 mou6 cung1 ngan4 hong4 zik1 jyun4 ak1 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an entertainer whose act consists of imitating other people, especially celebrities.

example.english: The TV station invited an impersonator to imitate Chow Yun-fat on the show.
example.traditional: 電視台請咗位模仿藝人喺節目入面扮周潤發。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi1 ceng2 zo2 wai6 mou4 fong2 ngai6 jan4 hai2 zit3 muk6 jap6 min6 baan6 zau1 jeon6 faat3
